title: The Maharashtra Bhil Naik Inams Abolition Act
full_text: The Maharashtra Bhil Naik Inams Abolition Act Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 195521 Act Number: 21 Enactment Date: 1955-06-03 Act Year: 1955 Short Title: The Maharashtra Bhil Naik Inams Abolition Act Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: Revenue & Forest Department Type: STATE Location: Maharashtra TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles The Maharashtra Bhil Naik Inams Abolition Act Show all section Section 1. Short title, extent and commencement. Section 2. Definitions. Section 3. Act not to apply to certain inams. Section 4. Abolition of Bhil Naik Inams and resumption of inam villages and lands. Section 5. Occupancy rights in respect of lands in inam villages and inam lands. Section 6. Uncultivated and waste lands and all property of the nature specified in section 37 of the Code vests in Government. Section 7. Method of compensation for abolition, etc. of other rights in lands. Section 8. Court-fees. Section 9. Finality of award of Collector and decision of Revenue Tribunal. Section 9A. Revisional powers in respect of awards made before commencement of Bom. XCIII of 1958. Section 10. Inquiries and proceedings to be judicial proceedings. Section 11. Amount of compensation to be payable in transferable bonds. Section 12. Provisions of Bom. LXVII of 1948 to govern relations of landlord and tenants. Section 13. Rules. Section 14. Saving.
